title: The circle
style: cinematic horror film still, vast frozen northern lake under a pale winter sky, lonely ice fishing shacks, black open water, cold steel-blue and white tones with warm lantern amber, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 1. One spot on Kettle Lake never freezes. Wade finally touched it. 🧊

Original fiction. Part 2 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Kettle Lake freezes so hard you can drive a truck across it. Every winter. Every inch. Except one.
scenes.image: vast frozen lake at dawn, pickup trucks and small wooden fishing shacks scattered across thick white ice

scenes.narration: Wade Morrow has fished that ice for twenty years. His shack sits a hundred yards from the spot the old-timers won't talk about.
scenes.image: weathered middle-aged ice fisherman in a heavy parka and fur hat standing beside a small wooden shack on a frozen lake

scenes.narration: It's a circle of open black water, about ten feet across. And it's perfectly round. Not roughly. Perfectly. Like someone drew it with a compass.
scenes.image: aerial view of a frozen white lake with one perfectly round patch of black open water in the middle

scenes.narration: At thirty below, it doesn't skim over. It doesn't even steam. It just sits there, flat and dark, like a hole cut in the world.
scenes.image: close-up of the razor-sharp edge where thick white ice meets perfectly still black water, no steam, frost crystals

scenes.narration: One January morning, Wade finally walks out to it. The ice creaks under his boots. Then the wind stops, right at the edge.
scenes.image: ice fisherman walking alone across a frozen lake toward a round black hole in the ice, long shadow on the snow

scenes.narration: He kneels. Pulls off one glove. And touches the water.
scenes.image: close-up of a bare weathered hand reaching down to touch dark still water at the edge of thick ice

scenes.narration: It's warm. Not lake warm. Bathwater warm. Body warm.
scenes.image: man's fingers dipped in black water, faint warm amber glow beneath the surface, frost on his sleeve

scenes.narration: Wade yanks his hand back. His fingers are pink and steaming. And the surface doesn't ripple. Not a single ring. Like the water didn't notice him. Or did, and decided to wait.
scenes.image: fisherman kneeling on the ice staring at his steaming hand, the black water beside him perfectly glassy and still

scenes.narration: That night, Wade watches the circle through the frost on his shack window.
scenes.image: view through a frosted shack window at night, a round dark patch on a moonlit frozen lake in the distance

scenes.narration: Under the moon, the black water is slowly turning lighter. Like something underneath is rising toward the surface.
scenes.image: round patch of lake water at night glowing faintly pale from below, a vast indistinct shape rising under the surface
